# Geraldton Skip Bins

> Skip bins in Geraldton, Waggrakine, Drummond Cove, Cape Burney and the Mid West. Tell us your suburb, size and waste type and get a free quote from one local skip bin operator.

Geraldton Skip Bins (geraldtonskipbins.com) is a free skip bin quote and referral service, not a skip hire company. It is run by Raf Web Studio. Visitors fill in a two-step quote form (suburb, skip size, waste type, then contact details) and the request goes to one local skip bin operator, who quotes, supplies the skip and sets the price and hire terms.

- Service: skip bin hire quotes
- Area: Geraldton, City of Greater Geraldton (WA), including Beresford, Bluff Point, Wonthella, Rangeway, Utakarra, Karloo, Wandina, Mount Tarcoola, Tarcoola Beach, Cape Burney, Spalding, Sunset Beach, Strathalbyn, Woorree, Waggrakine, Glenfield, Drummond Cove, Narngulu, Moonyoonooka, Walkaway
- Contact: the quote form on the homepage (no phone line, no payments taken)
- Prices: no price list; a local operator will quote for each job

## Quick answers

- **What areas does Geraldton Skip Bins cover, and is there a call-out fee?** We take skip bin quote requests from Geraldton and nearby areas, including Beresford, Bluff Point, Wonthella, Rangeway, Utakarra, Karloo, Wandina, Mount Tarcoola, Tarcoola Beach, Cape Burney, Spalding, Sunset Beach, Strathalbyn, Woorree, Waggrakine, Glenfield, Drummond Cove, Narngulu, Moonyoonooka, Walkaway. The quote service is free, so there's no call-out fee from us. The operator includes delivery and pick-up in its quote. Deliveries out to Walkaway, Moonyoonooka or other rural areas, extra hire days and difficult access can add to the price.
- **Do I need a licence or permit for a skip bin?** You don't need a licence to hire a skip. A skip wholly on your own property generally doesn't need approval. On a road or verge, yes: the City of Greater Geraldton requires a Licence to Obstruct a Thoroughfare or Verge, which covers skip bins and other bulk containers. Asbestos is different: asbestos can't go in a general skip. In WA, more than 10 m² of bonded asbestos, or any friable asbestos, must be removed by a licensed removalist.
- **What affects the price of a skip bin?** Skip bin prices depend on the bin size, the type and weight of the waste, how long you keep the bin, how far the truck travels and how easy access is. We don't publish a price list. Tell us about your job and a local operator will quote for it.
- **Who supplies the skip?** Geraldton Skip Bins is a free referral and quote service run by Raf Web Studio. We don't own skips or trucks. We pass your request to one local skip bin operator who services your area, and they quote, supply the skip and set the hire terms.
